file_walker._exclude_glob_note: Illustrative USER patterns only. Sensible defaults (node_modules, .git, dist, build, target, .next, __pycache__ + secret patterns .env* *.pem *.key id_* *secret* *.lock) are ALWAYS merged in and cannot be dropped. Convention (.gitignore-style): a pattern WITHOUT '/' matches a path segment at ANY depth ('coverage', '*.min.js'); a pattern WITH '/' is anchored to the work_dir root ('src/generated/**').
